headline: Committee passes petition deadline change, defers notice, day-counting, claims items

meeting.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meeting.voteItem: Proposed charter amendment standardizing deadlines for voter initiative, recall and charter amendment petitions
meeting.summary: The committee also filed the proposal on posting bill digests online. It recessed until June 16, 2026, when the notice and day-counting proposals are to return as one combined proposal and discussion of the claims proposal continues.
meeting.recap: The vice chair said the committee has 15 charter amendments (proposed changes to the County Charter) to consider.[[0:20:44]] The clerk's office proposed ending a Charter rule to print public hearing notices in a newspaper.[[0:26:28]] The committee deferred (put off) that proposal.[[0:51:28]] The clerk's office proposed 45 days for a first review of petitions and 30 days to review added signatures.[[0:53:45]] The committee passed it with six ayes and three members excused.[[1:11:19]] The committee deferred a proposal on counting days for deadlines, to combine it with the notice proposal.[[1:29:31]] Another proposal would have injury and damage claims filed directly with Corporation Counsel.[[1:30:43]] A deputy corporation counsel said that could make the office's attorneys witnesses in later lawsuits.[[1:34:46]] The committee deferred the claims proposal.[[2:14:12]] The committee voted six ayes to file (set aside) a proposal to post bill digests (summaries) online.[[2:15:34]] A proposal would remove the English translation of the state motto from the Charter preamble.[[2:18:14]] Another proposal would let the open space fund pay to remove wildfire fuel.[[2:22:54]] The committee voted six ayes to file it.[[2:25:08]] In the wrap-up, the vice chair said the committee passed the motto proposal.[[2:26:11]] The meeting recessed until June 16, 2026.[[2:29:47]]
decided: The committee passed the proposal to standardize petition review deadlines.
The committee deferred the day-counting proposal so it can be combined with the notice proposal.
The committee deferred the proposal on where claims are filed.
The committee voted to file the proposal on publishing bill digests online.
meeting.next: The notice and day-counting proposals will come back as one combined proposal on the 16th. Discussion of the claims proposal will continue on the 16th.
